scenes.narration: One of these boxes is hiding a DIAMOND — but which one?!
Is it the RED box, the BLUE box, or the GREEN box? Choose fast!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue green gift boxes row

scenes.narration: Three… two… one — let's find out!
Open the RED box and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack, no diamond here!
Open the GREEN box and… a pile of stinky socks?! Ewww, definitely not!
That means the BLUE box has the diamond — open it up! WOW, there it is, sparkling like crazy!
Did you get it right? Level TWO is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
